title: ilex crenata var. thomsonii
intro: Ilex crenata var. thomsonii, commonly known as Japanese Holly, is a variety of the Ilex crenata plant, native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Holly include promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and potentially treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Ilex crenata var. thomsonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
